claim: The safe-direction cost of A3 is far larger than the tier report shows. Clean upholds (every window ping inside the area, nothing set aside, F-GPS-LOGIC false) with ordinary GPS jitter now go to APPROVE. At ARRIVAL_GEOFENCE_M's low end (10 m) any ping between 10 and 50 m becomes an outlier, so the same uphold moves from R8 (B) to R11 (D), which clause 2 counts as decisive. The self-test and fuzz put every inside ping exactly on the venue point, which hides this. CW-F04's text says such pings 'settle the condition on their own', so an LLM applier will rule AUTO where the engine rules APPROVE.
how: Owner judgment, D39 (g) and the tier report: 600 simulated clean upholds with ordinary jitter, AUTO 235 before A3 and 29 after, all through ARRIVAL_GEOFENCE_M's 10 m low end; options listed for Jasper. V99 pins the effect. D29 as written is kept.

claim: This bug predates A3 and A3 did not change it. Pings are sorted by their timestamp string, not by time. When GPS timestamps in one case mix UTC offsets, a real two-minute departure is sorted out of place and set aside as an outlier, so the fee is upheld where the rules waive it. A3's trigger now holds the case at APPROVE, but the trace tells the reviewer the pings were outliers.
how: Pre-existing defect fixed: pings are sorted by instant (T(timestamp)), not by text; V98 (pings written in UTC) is now R4 WAIVE_FEE; recorded as D39 (i).

claim: F-GPS-LOGIC, and the sensitivity row move through it, fires on pings that cannot affect the arrival or the presence. Examples are pings set aside between the arrival and a later window start (advance bookings, organizer late driver_wait_start), or before an arrival the platform check already confirms. This sends routine cases to approval (safe direction). CW-F04's text says 'none was set aside' without saying over which range.
how: F-GPS-LOGIC counts only set-aside pings that could change the presence (in the window) or the arrival (CW-R06's moment range; with the platform check, only at or after the indication); CW-F04B text, census and engine agree; V97 pins it.

claim: CW-F04B words the later-confirmation item as conditional on the start moving ('so the wait start moved'), but the engine sets F-GPS-LOGIC on ARRIVAL_UNCONFIRMED whether or not the start moved.
